title: Sprint 1 — HTML Foundations
description: Learn to craft the foundational structure of web pages using accessible and semantic HTML to ensure your sites are optimized for all users.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Document Structure & Semantics
tickets.description: Set up the core structure of your web pages. You will create a solid document foundation, organize your content logically with semantic headings, and design a contact form that everyone can easily use.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.1 — Build a Semantic Page Skeleton
tasks.description: Create the main structural layout for your webpage, establishing key sections like headers, footers, and main content areas.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.2 — Headings Hierarchy & Content Sectioning
tasks.description: Organize a typical blog post with clear and meaningful heading levels to improve readability and structure.

tasks.title: Task 1.1.3 — Forms & Input Elements
tasks.description: Design a fully functional contact form that safely collects user information with clear inputs.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Media, Tables & Accessibility
tickets.description: Enhance your pages with media and complex data. You will integrate images, build clear data tables, and make your site more accessible for users relying on screen readers.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.1 — Images, Figures & Media
tasks.description: Incorporate rich media such as images and video into your pages, ensuring there's fallback content for a smooth user experience.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.2 — Data Tables
tasks.description: Present information clearly using organized tables, making data easy to scan and understand.

tasks.title: Task 1.2.3 — ARIA & Accessibility
tasks.description: Ensure your forms are inclusive and usable by everyone by utilizing advanced accessibility attributes.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — HTML Best Practices
tickets.description: Optimize your web pages for search engines and learn how to seamlessly link content together. You will also practice identifying and fixing structural issues.

tasks.title: Task 1.3.1 — Meta Tags & SEO Structure
tasks.description: Implement metadata to improve your page's visibility in search results and social media shares.

tasks.title: Task 1.3.2 — Linking, Anchors & Embedded Content
tasks.description: Create a central hub that links out to various resources, seamlessly connecting different parts of your site.

tasks.title: Task 1.3.3 — HTML Validation Challenge
tasks.description: Develop your debugging skills by locating and resolving intentional structural errors on a sample page.
